summary: Tested Silence Notifications feature for Remote Sessions page. All 7 backend tests pass. Frontend verified: bell icon button toggles between Bell/BellOff icons, amber styling when silenced, 'Notifications are silenced' banner with Resume button, toast messages for silenced/resumed states.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/remote-sessions/notification-status correctly returns {silenced: bool} and requires admin auth
POST /api/remote-sessions/silence-notifications correctly toggles state and persists to anydesk_settings collection
_is_silenced() helper properly checks DB for notifications_silenced setting
notify_admins_session_event and notify_admins_flag both check _is_silenced() before sending push notifications
Backend logs 'Notifications silenced — skipping push for {event_type}' when silenced
Frontend silence button has data-testid='silence-notifications-btn' and toggles Bell/BellOff icons
Silenced banner has data-testid='silenced-banner' with Resume button (data-testid='resume-notifications-btn')
Toast messages correctly show 'Notifications silenced' and 'Notifications resumed'
seed_data_creation: Test session events created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Silence Notifications feature fully tested. Key endpoints: GET /api/remote-sessions/notification-status (returns {silenced: bool}), POST /api/remote-sessions/silence-notifications (toggles state). State stored in anydesk_settings collection with key='notifications_silenced'. Frontend data-testid attributes: silence-notifications-btn (bell icon in header), silenced-banner (amber banner when silenced), resume-notifications-btn (Resume button in banner). When silenced=true, notify_admins_session_event and notify_admins_flag skip push notifications and log 'Notifications silenced — skipping' message.

features_tested.backend_silence_toggle_changes_state: PASS - First call returns silenced=true, second returns silenced=false
features_tested.backend_session_log_when_silenced: PASS - Session events still processed, but push notifications skipped
features_tested.backend_logs_skipping_message: PASS - Logs 'Notifications silenced — skipping push for session_start'
features_tested.frontend_silence_button_exists: PASS - Bell icon button with data-testid='silence-notifications-btn'
features_tested.frontend_silenced_banner_appears: PASS - Banner with 'Notifications are silenced' text appears when silenced
features_tested.frontend_resume_button_works: PASS - Clicking Resume hides banner and restores notifications
features_tested.frontend_toast_silenced: PASS - Toast 'Notifications silenced' appears when silencing
features_tested.frontend_toast_resumed: PASS - Toast 'Notifications resumed' appears when resuming
features_tested.frontend_bell_icon_styling: PASS - Button has amber styling when silenced, normal styling when active
